name: run_shell_command
description: Runs a zsh shell command. Returns stdout, stderr, and exit code. Use for any terminal task.

command.description: The shell command to execute. Will be run via /bin/zsh -c

workingDirectory.description: Working directory for the command. Defaults to user home if not specified.

timeoutSeconds.description: Timeout in seconds before the command is killed. Default is 30.

name: read_file
description: Reads a file and returns its contents. Supports tilde paths (~/).

path.description: Absolute or tilde-expanded path to the file to read

maxLines.description: Maximum number of lines to read. Reads entire file if not specified.

name: write_file
description: Writes text content to a file. Creates the file and parent directories if needed.

path.description: Absolute or tilde-expanded path to write to

content.description: The text content to write to the file

append.description: If true, appends to existing file instead of overwriting

name: list_directory
description: Lists files and subdirectories at a path with sizes. Supports tilde paths.

path.description: Path to the directory to list

showHidden.description: If true, shows hidden files (starting with .)

depth.description: Maximum depth for recursive listing. 1 = only immediate children.

name: create_directory
description: Creates a directory (including parent directories) at the given path.

path.description: Path of the directory to create

name: delete_file
description: Moves a file or directory to Trash (or permanently deletes if permanent=true). DESTRUCTIVE.

path.description: Path of the file or directory to delete

permanent.description: If true, permanently deletes instead of moving to Trash. DANGEROUS.

name: move_file
description: Moves or renames a file or directory from source to destination.

sourcePath.description: Source path of the file/directory to move

destinationPath.description: Destination path (including new filename if renaming)

name: web_search
description: Searches the web using Brave Search (primary) with DuckDuckGo as fallback. Returns the top search results including titles, URLs, and text snippets.

query.description: The search query to look up on the web

name: run_applescript
description: Executes an AppleScript string and returns the result. Use this to control any scriptable macOS application (Finder, Safari, Chrome, System Settings, etc.).

name: take_screenshot
description: Captures a screenshot of the entire screen and saves it to a PNG file. Returns the file path. Requires Screen Recording permission.

savePath.description: Path to save the screenshot PNG. Defaults to ~/Desktop/apex_screenshot_<timestamp>.png

windowOnly.description: If true, captures only the frontmost window instead of the full screen

name: read_clipboard
description: Reads the current text content of the macOS clipboard (pasteboard) and returns it.

name: write_clipboard
description: Sets the macOS clipboard (pasteboard) to the specified text content.

text.description: The text to copy to the clipboard

name: send_notification
description: Sends a macOS user notification that appears in Notification Center. Use this to alert the user when a long-running task completes.

body.description: The body text of the notification

subtitle.description: Optional subtitle shown below the title

name: get_system_info
description: Returns detailed information about the macOS system including OS version, hardware model, chip, RAM, storage, and network info.

name: get_running_processes
description: Returns a list of currently running macOS applications (user-visible apps, not background daemons).

includeBackground.description: If true, includes background/hidden processes. If false (default), only shows user-visible apps.

name: get_frontmost_app
description: Returns the bundle ID, name, and process ID of the currently active (frontmost) macOS application.

name: store_memory
description: Stores or updates a key-value memory record in the on-device SQLite database. Use this to remember important system locations, file changes, or status of long-running tasks.

key.description: The topic or identifier for this memory (e.g., 'task_status', 'project_root')

name: search_memory
description: Searches the long-term SQLite memory database for entries matching the query keyword.

query.description: Search keyword to match against keys or values. If empty, lists the most recent memories.

name: control_app
description: Performs reliable, pre-tested GUI automation actions on common macOS apps (Safari, Chrome, Finder, System Settings).

parameter.description: Argument for the action (e.g., URL for 'open_url', folder path for 'open_folder', pane ID for 'open_preference_pane')

name: control_accessibility
description: Performs UI automation actions on the active application window using accessibility (AXUIElement) APIs. Requires Accessibility permissions.

elementId.description: The registry ID of the element (e.g. 'elem_1') - required for click, set_text, focus

textValue.description: The text value to enter - required for set_text

name: control_browser
description: Controls a headless, windowless web browser (Safari/WebKit based) to open pages, scrape content, click elements, and fill forms.

url.description: The URL to navigate to - required for open_url

selector.description: CSS selector for the target element - required for click_element and input_text

textValue.description: The text value to input - required for input_text

name: update_plan
description: Sets or updates the current execution plan steps to be visualized in the Plan Dashboard.

name: delegate_task
description: Delegates a specific sub-task to a specialized sub-agent (developer, executor, controller, researcher, linter, uiDesigner, planner) and returns their final response report.

agentType.description: The type of sub-agent to delegate the task to (developer, executor, controller, researcher, linter, uiDesigner, planner)

taskDescription.description: The detailed task instructions and context for the sub-agent to execute.

name: convene_meeting
description: Convenes a round-robin debate among multiple specialized sub-agents to find consensus on a complex topic.

topic.description: The discussion topic or problem to debate

participants.description: List of sub-agent types participating (developer, executor, controller, researcher, linter, uiDesigner, planner)

name: create_skill
description: Creates a new custom skill/tool by writing a shell or python script and registering its schema.

skillName.description: Name of the skill to create (snake_case)

skillDescription.description: Short description of what the skill does

scriptContent.description: The zsh or python script content

parameterSchemaJSON.description: The JSON Schema of the parameters this script expects

name: run_workflow
description: Runs a pre-defined multi-agent state-graph workflow pipeline (Codex -> Auditor -> Nexus) to resolve a development task.

task.description: The task or bug description to solve using the pipeline

name: audit_projects
description: Audits Xcode projects in a directory for potential code style, warning, and configuration issues.

directoryPath.description: The path to the directory containing Xcode projects to audit

name: analyze_image
description: Analyzes the visual contents of a local image file based on a natural language query (multimodal visual QA).

imagePath.description: Path to the local image file to analyze

query.description: The visual query or question about the image content

name: detect_image_text
description: Runs optical character recognition (OCR) on a local image file to extract readable text.

imagePath.description: Path to the local image file to perform OCR on
